title: The Truth of the Haunted House
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Dr. Tomoaki Araide, Sonoko) omitted by convention. Old lower-fidelity file (cases/ep274-275_the_truth_of_the_haunted_house.json) put the park murder 'two years ago' and used event nodes / generic 'knows' edges; the transcript repeatedly and explicitly says the murder of Rui Tabuchi was FOUR years before the present (e.g. 0274 line 242 'burnt to death in that park four years ago', 0275 lines 245-246 'Four years ago?', line 281 'the case that occurred four years before') -- corrected here. The old file also omitted the second killer entirely (an unnamed, scarred accomplice hiding in the abandoned building next door, whom Banchou was secretly feeding) -- added here as a full backstory person node since he is co-culprit of the original murder even though he is not the one on-screen orchestrating the haunting. Culprit identity itself (Kikuji Banchou, s1/p2) matches the transcript -- no label error there, just missing depth. One passage (0275 lines 194-200, the 'multi-function remote control ... Otonashi-san cooperated with me' exchange) is ambiguous in this fan translation about whether Otonashi knowingly helped broadcast the fake ghost video or was simply an unwitting tool (his TV/room were used while he and guests were drugged with chloroform); modeled conservatively here as unwitting, per the episode's stated goal of scaring Otonashi into moving out -- inconsistent with him being a willing accomplice. case_type: murder (with a present-day concealment/haunting scheme built on top of the four-year-old crime).

clues.desc: Right after the ghost appeared on Otonashi's TV, Conan checked the video player in that room and found no tape loaded -- rules out a locally played tape (clearing Yotsuya) and points to a signal broadcast in from elsewhere instead.

When the window 'shadow' dissipated, only Banchou reacted by instantly slamming the window open before any moths could be seen lingering -- the reaction of someone who knew the trick would be exposed if even one moth remained.

Phenolphthalein only turns red in an alkaline solution, but urine is neutral or acidic -- so the toilet's 'blood' could not have come from urine alone and required ammonia to have been added on purpose.
